request.description:
Asymmetric Signature API allow you to generate signature for all Xendit SNAP APIs. The purpose of this API is to simulate signature generation, and will work in Test mode only. For API integration, you MUST generate the signature NOT by calling this API, but by calculating the signature based on SNAP algorithm. [Documentation here](https://xendit.stoplight.io/docs/api-webhook-signature/branches/main/ghau5r7abzpjg-signature-and-key-exchange#signature-and-key-exchange)

You will need the following information to generate signature

- \[Header\] X-TIMESTAMP, timestamp of the request in ISO8601 format. Example 2022-08-31T06:00:00Z
- \[Header\] Private_key, this is your RSA 2048 format in Xendit
- \[Header\] httpmethod, which is the HTTP Method on the API you want to use
- \[Header\] endpointurl, which is the relative URL of the API path you want to use
- \[Body\] Request body is the request body of the API you want to use and sign (must be in JSON format)
    

You will get `signature` value which you could attach to `X-SIGNATURE` header on the API you want to use

header.description: (Required) Your Xendit merchant ID

(Required) Also known as idempotency key. Provided to prevent duplicate requests. Can be equal to any UUID. Idempotency keys are stored on the request layer; it expires after 24 hours from the first request.
(Required) Non-repudiation signature for the request. See [this article](docs/Xendit-OAuth2-Security.md) for more info.
(Required) Timestamp for the non-repudiation signature. Format must be yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssTZD.
(Required) Device identification on which the API services is currently being accessed by the end user. If not available, set to 'unknown'.
